title: StandardWork
description: Standard work procedures for the council governance layer (.council/standard-work.json). Evolves through per-cycle PDCA retrospectives.

version.description: Semantic version of this standard-work document.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.

updated_by.description: Agent or human that last updated this document.

ratified_decision_id.description: DEC-NNNN identifier of the decision that ratified the most recent change.

sizing_heuristics.description: Sprint sizing guidance derived from project history.

recommended_weight_spread.description: Recommended weight distribution pattern (e.g. '2-3 heavy criteria + 3-4 light').

failure_patterns.description: Documented failure patterns with mitigations (FP-CF-001 through FP-CF-005 seed the initial doc).

pattern_id.description: Unique identifier for this failure pattern (e.g. FP-CF-001).

applicable_to.description: Conditions or sprint types this procedure applies to.

loop_shapes.description: Named reusable structures for HOW loops are organized (e.g. 'Plan-Then-Execute Loop', 'Probe Campaign', 'Verify-Until-Pass'). Distinct from procedures: loop-shapes use the pattern-language form (problem / forces / solution / consequences / when-not-to-use) and are abstract structural patterns rather than ordered step lists. Candidates are ratified via the standard 4-stage nemawashi walkthrough; status moves candidate -> ratified. See docs/design/adr-0005-loop-shape-pattern-category.md.

shape_id.description: Unique identifier slug for this loop-shape (e.g. 'plan-then-execute-loop').

problem.description: The recurring problem this shape addresses.

forces.description: The competing forces / tradeoffs the shape balances.

solution.description: The structural solution this shape proposes.

consequences.description: What the shape costs and gains; the tradeoffs accepted.

when_not_to_use.description: Conditions under which this shape is the wrong choice.

evidence_sprints.description: Sprint numbers where this loop-shape has been observed or applied. Required to be non-empty; candidates without observed evidence are not ratifiable.

ratified_decision_id.description: DEC-NNNN identifier of the nemawashi decision that ratified this loop-shape. Null or absent while status is 'candidate'.

status.description: Lifecycle status. 'candidate' = proposed but not yet through nemawashi. 'ratified' = approved via 4-stage walkthrough. 'deprecated' = retired but kept for audit traceability.

allOf.description: A ratified loop-shape must carry the DEC id of the nemawashi decision that ratified it.
A candidate loop-shape has not been ratified, so it must not carry a ratified_decision_id (null or absent only).
